//: Paths are resolved relative to the journey/ folder unless absolute.

images.//: The derivatives ship inside the repo, so these numbers are a storage
images.//2: budget as much as a quality setting. GitHub Pages refuses to publish a
images.//3: site over 1 GB, and 5,677 photos means every 10 KB per photo costs
images.//4: 57 MB of that ceiling. `npm run images` prints the running total.
images.//5: AVIF is slow to encode but roughly 40% smaller than WebP at matching
images.//6: quality. Set format to "webp" to trade about 400 MB for hours of CPU,
images.//7: or "jpeg" for maximum compatibility and roughly 2.5x the size.
images.//8: Videos are excluded from the site by default: 322 clips weigh 6.2 GB,
images.//9: six times the entire Pages budget. "poster" keeps a still frame from
images.//10: each one (needs ffmpeg on PATH); "skip" drops them entirely.

locate.//: Coastal photos fall outside every state polygon, for two unrelated reasons
locate.//2: worth telling apart. Within a few hundred metres it is mesh resolution —
locate.//3: IBGE boundaries are not survey-grade and beaches sit seaward of them, so
locate.//4: you were on dry sand. Beyond that you were genuinely on the water.
locate.//5: Photos with no GPS at all get their location inferred from the nearest
locate.//6: GPS-tagged photo in time, if one exists within this many hours.
